source_inspections.evidence_extract: Reuters reviewed Justice Department-provided texts of six California county letters signed by First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bilal Essayli. The letters listed federal match counts of 1,754 in Orange, 1,355 in Riverside, 1,133 in San Bernardino, 334 in Ventura, 180 in Santa Barbara and 63 in San Luis Obispo, and warned of significant federal scrutiny and legal exposure. Reuters also reported a 407-person Contra Costa demand and attributed to The New York Times that versions were sent to all 58 counties; the directly reviewed six-letter scope and separately attributed statewide scope are preserved distinctly.
